definitions.explanation: The price at which goods are sold from a wholesaler to a retailer, before the retail markup. Lower than the retail price that consumers pay.

examples.japanese: {卸値|おろしね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れた→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧。
examples.english: I purchased it at wholesale price.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{卸値|おろしね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧くらいだ。
examples.english: The wholesale price of this product is about half the retail price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{卸値|おろしね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧、⟦{小売店|こうりてん}→小売店：20689_kouriten⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なく→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Wholesale prices rose due to soaring raw material costs, forcing retailers to raise prices as well.

notes:
USAGE:
{卸値|おろしね} is a commerce term used in business and trade. It is sometimes encountered in everyday speech when shops advertise products at wholesale prices to attract customers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卸値|おろしね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ (to sell at wholesale price)
- {卸値|おろしね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れる→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧ (to purchase at wholesale price)
- {卸値|おろしね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (wholesale prices rise)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ means retail price. ⟦{卸売|おろしうり}→卸売：05083_oroshiuri⟧ means wholesale (the business of selling in bulk), and ⟦{卸|おろし}→卸：10906_oroshi⟧ alone can refer to wholesale trade.
